review_brief:
# Review: c690e739e0ce

Built a native two-setting row-reflection family. The canonical default remains
exactly `(rule! flip-lr)`; the alternative derives the unique global minority
color, uses its complete row mask as an intermediate, then reverses only those
rows. The base generator also now rejects string rows instead of silently
coercing their digits into cells.

The first passing sampler was not retained. Adversarial search found minimum
lessons compatible with left-half-only, edge-only, exactly-one/odd marker-count,
fixed global-count, fixed frequency-threshold, and first/last-N row rules. The
minimum was rebuilt constructively as crossed 10x12 and 14x16 scenes with 2 vs 9
selected rows, selector/decoy counts 3/4 vs 18/19, both-side markers, and a
pure-dense threshold guard. The probe was also changed to compare compact row
masks so the full 30x30 audit remains cheap.

Final bounded audit: 384 episodes (64 seeds x demo counts 2/3/6 x 2 settings),
all ten selector colors, 402 row masks, exact/threshold frequencies 1..40,
first/last caps 1..8, fixed colors/ranks/positions, parity/halves, row statistics,
and partial/wrong intermediates. No profile failures, query-changing survivors,
or non-declared distribution-equivalent survivors remained. Tampered labels,
stale programs, duplicate/malformed inputs, forged certificates, and public/private
leakage were rejected.

Twenty-one task tests passed. Protected Racket replayed 80 retained pairs, native
authoring preflight passed 32 evaluations, the qualified counterfactual witness
changed the final output, and 16 sequential public views verified. These are
finite reviewer checks, not universal uniqueness, owner acceptance, or training
admission.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

parametric_work.limits: Finite sampled and rival-rule evidence does not prove universal uniqueness; the alternative grammar requires a unique global minority color.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The selected color and the complete row mask containing that color.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Count all colors and select the unique globally least-frequent color.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Reverse every complete row in that mask left-to-right and copy all other rows unchanged.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The rows eligible for reflection are not known until A derives the input-dependent minority color; substituting the second-rarest color changes the row mask and therefore the final grid.

parametric_work.summary: Reviewer-ready native prototype: reflection_scope selects exact canonical all-row reflection or input-derived minority-row reflection. The declared 2-demo minimum, 6-demo maximum, four-query schedule, 30x30 stress, adversarial search, protected execution, source inventory, authoring preflight, public projection, and causal counterfactual all pass. Owner exact-source qualification/acceptance and training admission remain pending.

target_report.summary: Repaired strict base-grid validation and built a complete native row-scope parametric family with exact canonical default, crossed two-demo teaching, four sequential queries, protected-Racket evidence, deep adversarial repair, author qualification, and a replayable causal witness.
